name: Bruce Mackenzie
bio:
Bruce's journey into motorsport was a bit unconventional. He spent years as a meticulous machinist in the mining industry before realizing his precision could be applied to a more exciting field. After taking some specialized courses in automotive engineering, he managed to land an entry-level quality control role with a small racing team. 

Bruce is all about the numbers and the data. He approaches every inspection with a systematic and thorough method, ensuring no detail is overlooked. He believes that a pragmatic approach, focusing on proven techniques and established standards, is the best way to maintain the highest levels of quality and prevent costly errors on the track. While he may lack extensive experience in the racing world, his unwavering commitment to accuracy and his dedication to learning make him a valuable asset.

physical.hairStyle: short, neatly combed back, receding hairline
physical.description: Bruce is of average height, with a slightly stocky build and a focused gaze.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook and pen to jot down observations.
Has a habit of tapping his pen against surfaces when concentrating.
Insists on using a magnifying glass for close inspections, even when not strictly necessary.
